# KaraoQ

> KaraoQ turns any gathering into karaoke night. Create a room in your browser,
> guests join from their phones by scanning a QR code or entering a short code,
> everyone searches YouTube and adds songs to one shared queue, and the lyrics
> play on any screen. No downloads, no accounts, free to host and free to join.

Key facts:
- Free to host and free to join. Songs stream from YouTube, so there is nothing to buy, rent, or subscribe to.
- No app or install — runs entirely in the browser on phones, tablets, laptops, and smart TVs.
- No account or sign-up for hosts or guests.
- Guests join by scanning a QR code or entering a short room code.
- Songs come from YouTube (millions of karaoke tracks, instrumentals, and lyric videos).
- Show the lyrics on a TV by casting (AirPlay / Google Cast), an HDMI cable, or a pop-out video window.
- Works for house parties, dorms, team events, bars, and venues.
- Available in English, Japanese, Filipino, Spanish, Korean, Portuguese, German, Indonesian, Czech, and French.

## Guides
- [How to host karaoke at home](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/how-to-host-karaoke-at-home): Run a karaoke night at home with no machine — browser, YouTube, and any screen.
- [How to do karaoke on your TV](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/karaoke-on-your-tv): Per-device walkthrough — smart TV browser, Chromecast, Apple TV, Fire TV Stick, Roku, HDMI — plus the fix for delayed vocals.
- [Free YouTube karaoke](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/free-youtube-karaoke): Use YouTube as an endless free karaoke library — finding the right version, songs with no karaoke track, ads, unplayable videos.
- [Home karaoke setup guide](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/home-karaoke-setup): Five levels from a $0 phone-and-TV night to a mixer, powered speakers and UHF wireless mics — what each costs, what to buy, what to skip.
- [Karaoke for bars and venues](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/karaoke-for-bars-and-venues): Let guests queue from their phones — no KJ, no dedicated machine.
- [Cheap home karaoke setup](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/cheap-home-karaoke-setup): Under $200 — a party speaker with a mic input and wired mics; why a karaoke machine is the wrong buy; the Bluetooth delay trap.
- [Best YouTube karaoke channels](https://www.karaoq.live/guide/best-youtube-karaoke-channels): Sing King, KaraFun, Stingray, Party Tyme, Sing2Piano, CC Karaoke — and how to queue them for a party.
